hace 2 días • Visible para cualquier persona dentro o fuera de LinkedIn Seguir ▶️ Save The Date! 📅 3-4 June 2026 ENDR Conference Gijón 2026 - “Advanced manufacturing and systems integration for a strong defence industry”
In the framework of The European Network of Defence-related Regions - ENDR, the European Commission’s Directorate-General for Defence Industry and Space - DG DEFIS, together with ENDR member Asturias Hub defensa ( ASTURIAS HUB DE DEFENSA) - Asturias Technology Business Association for the development of the Defence Industry - will host the European conference “Advanced manufacturing and systems integration for a strong defence industry”.
🗺️ The event will take place Gijón, Asturias (Spain), on 3-4 June 2026, at the Laboral Centro de Arte y Creación Industrial.
🔎 The conference will bring together key policymakers, industry leaders, SMEs, and stakeholders from the defence and dual-use entrepreneurial ecosystem, alongside civilian technology innovators, clusters, and defence business associations. It will also engage academia, research and technology organisations, higher education and VET providers, research funding bodies, specialised media, as well as EU, national, and regional authorities, and international organisations.
Registration: https://lnkd.in/eT2Hjm8T

hace 5 meses • Editado • Visible para cualquier persona dentro o fuera de LinkedIn Seguir 📢 NFP training workshop and EOA General Assembly under way
📍 As part of the EOA - Enhancing Opportunities for All project the Croatian Defense Industry Competitiveness Cluster (CDICC) currently hosts in Slovenia the second training workshop for EDF National Focal Points, alternates, and other members of national EDF teams, aiming to strengthen NFP’s practical EDF support knowledge and skills. A particular focus is set on the Slovenian EDF experience (both from EDF consortium leaders and partners) and the management of IPR in EDF projects. The EOA project consortium took advantage of this onsite gathering to hold its annual General Assembly.
To close the 3-day workshop the Slovenian Ministry of Defence will tomorrow present its experience with EDF participation and emerging challenges. Participants will also be introduced to the GOIS Grozd obrambne industrije Slovenije, g.i.z. with discussions on national approaches to innovation, research and development, and the exchange of good practices.
⏪ You can replay previous EOA training and webinar sessions on EDF best practices are available on EOA’s Youtube channel: https://lnkd.in/euKYVBz2. Stay tuned !

The EUDIS Defence Hackathon Spring 2026 is now open to experienced innovators working on defence-relevant and dual-use technologies. From 26 to 28 March 2026, eight onsite hackathons across the EU and Norway will bring together startups, engineers, researchers and defence professionals to work on real airspace defence challenges alongside experts and end-users.
